title: GUI-Lens: Enabling Precise GUI Grounding for Off-the-Shelf VLMs via Coarse-to-Fine Cropping
abstract: arXiv:2608.03270v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagate to the final result. In this paper, we introduce GUI-Lens, a coarse-to-fine grounding framework that allows a general-purpose VLM to determine the target through active visual observations. Specifically, GUI-Lens extracts OCR text and detected UI components from the screenshot and presents their positions as coordinate references. translated_title: GUI-Lens：通过由粗到细的裁剪为现成视觉语言模型实现精确的GUI定位
translated_abstract: GUI定位（grounding）将自然语言指令映射到点击位置，对于构建可靠的GUI智能体至关重要。该任务在高分辨率、元素密集的界面上仍然困难，因为视觉语言模型（VLM）可能识别出所请求的控件，却无法将其定位到足以进行交互的精确程度。大多数现有方法提供各种形式的定位辅助，但仍依赖直接的点击预测，导致视觉歧义或不准确的初始估计会传播到最终结果。本文提出GUI-Lens，一个由粗到细的定位框架，使通用VLM能够通过主动的视觉观察来确定目标。具体而言，GUI-Lens从截图中提取OCR文本和检测到的UI组件，并将其位置作为坐标参考呈现。利用指令、当前视图和这些参考信息，VLM选择（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GUI-Lens提出了一种由粗到细的GUI定位框架，通过将截图中的OCR文本和UI组件位置作为坐标参考，让现成的视觉语言模型通过主动视觉观察逐步裁剪缩放，从而实现精确的界面元素点击定位。
en_tdlr: GUI-Lens is a coarse-to-fine grounding framework that enables off-the-shelf VLMs to precisely locate GUI targets through active visual observation, using OCR text and detected UI components as coordinate references to iteratively select and crop regions instead of relying on direct click prediction.
